summary: Shows how to warp a character's root motion to line up with a target point: add Motion Warping notify-state windows in an Animation Montage, add the Motion Warping component, set warp targets in Blueprint, and play the montage (worked punch-to-target example).
keys: Add or Update Warp Target from Transform
Add Root Motion Modifier Skew Warp
gotchas: Requires the Motion Warping plugin to be enabled
Animation must have Root Motion enabled (EnableRootMotion)
Warp Target Name in Blueprint must match the name set on the montage notify

summary: 3ds Max Vertex Animation tool workflow for per-frame (non-timeline) mesh sequences: paint the sequence into UVs with Sequence Painter, export, then play it in UE via a World Position Offset material using MS_SequencePainter_SequenceFlipbook.
gotchas: Meshes must be converted to Editable Poly in 3ds Max
Meshes must be selected in playback order
Import with Auto Generate Collision, Remove Degenerates and Generate Lightmap UVs disabled

summary: 3ds Max Vertex Animation tool workflow that bakes timeline-animated mesh deformation into an EXR position texture and BMP normal texture, with exact texture/mesh import settings and a material using MS_VertexAnimationTools_MorphTargets.
gotchas: Textures must use No Mip Maps, UI group, SRGB off, Nearest filter
Number of Morph Targets must equal the texture's Y value
Every setup step must be followed exactly or it may not work

summary: Explains per-light screen-space Contact Shadows (depth-buffer ray marching) for extra character detail and shadowing parallax occlusion materials, and how to enable them via a light's Contact Shadow Length.
gotchas: Disabled by default (length 0)
Larger lengths produce more noise because sample count stays constant
Parallax occlusion materials should output pixel depth offset

summary: Covers Distance Field Shadows for movable lights: enabling them, using Source Radius/Light Source Angle for soft penumbras, combining with Cascaded Shadow Maps at distance, visualizing mesh distance fields, and performance/optimization notes.
gotchas: Requires Generate Mesh Distance Fields in Project Settings and Movable lights
Mesh distance fields cannot be generated at runtime
Light source radius sphere must not intersect scene geometry
Computed at half resolution; jagged edges can appear

summary: Hub page for Nanite virtualized geometry linking to the overview, technical details, working with Nanite content, hybrid workflows, Nanite Foliage, Nanite Assemblies and Nanite with Landscapes.

Guided tour of the Valley of the Ancient UE5 sample showing how it uses Nanite, Lumen, Modeling mode, Packed Level Instances, Chaos fracture/cache, Sky Atmosphere and Niagara, World Partition/OFPA/Data Layers, Motion Warping vaulting, Control Rig/FBIK, Game Feature plugins, Enhanced Input, MetaSounds and Quartz.
gotchas: Very graphically intensive; recommends RTX 2080-class GPU, 64 GB RAM and an SSD
Nanite requires Nvidia Maxwell / AMD GCN or newer
Avoid loading all World Partition cells at once
Nanite does not support deformation (static meshes only)

summary: Reference overview of Runtime Virtual Texturing: RVT asset, volume, material types, Runtime Virtual Texture Output/Sample nodes, Draw in Main Pass, LOD/mip and sort-priority settings, baking streaming low mips, and stats/CVars for debugging.
gotchas: Rendered objects should be Static; skeletal/animated/movable meshes are poor candidates
Disable collision on primitives only rendered to the RVT (not automatic)
No support for virtual textures in materials that fill RVTs
No instance culling/LOD selection for Instanced Static Meshes

summary: Step-by-step: enable virtual texture support, create an RVT asset, convert a Landscape material to write/sample an RVT with a feature-switch fallback, place and size an RVT Volume, and blend a landscape spline road into the terrain.
gotchas: Requires project restart after enabling virtual texture support
Actors must be inside the RVT Volume bounds
Landscape renders black if setup is wrong

summary: Explains Streaming Virtual Texturing versus mip-based streaming, how to convert textures/materials (Convert to Virtual Texture, Virtual sampler types), UDIM import, lookup/stack costs and visualization/stat commands.
gotchas: Texture dimensions must be power of 2
VT sampling always costs more than regular texture sampling
Streaming is reactive so tiles can visibly pop in
Enabling VT manually on a texture breaks materials until sampler type is set to Virtual

summary: Describes virtual texture page table and physical pool memory, configuring Fixed/Transient pools in Project Settings, residency and oversubscription, mip bias, and debugging with residency HUD and pool-usage dumps.
gotchas: Pools are fixed size and cannot grow at runtime unless auto-grow is used
Transient pool entries are lost between editor sessions unless copied to Fixed Pools
Pool Auto Grow in Editor has no effect in cooked builds
100% residency causes flickering and IO thrashing

summary: Reference tables for virtual texturing project settings, texture editor options, RVT asset properties, RVT sample node settings, RVT volume settings, and per-primitive/landscape/spline RVT properties.
keys: Enable virtual texture on texture import
gotchas: Several settings require restarting the editor
RVT max of 4096 tiles
RVT sample node settings must match the bound asset
Large negative MipBias or MipLevel 0 can thrash the physical pool

summary: Explains Cull Distance Volumes, which hide Actors beyond distances set per object size via Cull Distance pairs, with example values and best practices for avoiding popping.
gotchas: Pairs are not interpolated; overlapping pairs use the most aggressive value
A Cull Distance of 0 means never culled
Pairs only apply if lower than the Actor's own Max Draw Distance

summary: Hub page for Apple platform development: quick start, requirements, device setup, remote Mac builds, Windows Metal shader compiler, packaging, provisioning, Xcode debugging and iOS profiling/size optimization.
gotchas: A Mac is required for signed C++ builds; Windows can ship Blueprint-only projects
Xcode is required to debug on Apple devices

summary: Video-tutorial module page (First Game UI series) for building an animated 3-2-1 start countdown in UMG and triggering it from Blueprint at level start; the page has only section headings and project-file links.
Video-tutorial module page for a countdown game timer: tracking time in Blueprint, formatting as minutes:seconds, and binding a UMG widget to display it; content is section headings only.
Video-tutorial module page for UMG Game Over and Level Complete screens with restart/quit/load-level buttons, triggered on timer expiry or finish line; content is section headings only.
Short descriptions of AI sensing components: AIPerceptionComponent, PawnNoiseEmitterComponent and PawnSensingComponent.
gotchas: PawnNoiseEmitter and PawnSensing do nothing on network clients

summary: Reference for the AI Perception Component and Stimuli Source: sense configs (Damage, Hearing, Prediction, Sight, Team, Touch) and their properties, perception events, Blueprint functions, forgetting stale actors, and perception debugging.
gotchas: Affiliation can only be defined in C++; in Blueprint use Detect Neutrals plus Tags
Max Age forgetting requires Project Settings > Engine > AI System > Forget Stale Actors
Set Sense Enabled only works for senses already configured
Debug with apostrophe key then Numpad 4

summary: Hub page for the MassEntity data-oriented framework linking to Mass Avoidance, MassEntity overview, MassGameplay overview, Mass Debugger and the simplified Mass Processor/Query Executor API.
gotchas: Tagged experimental

summary: Hub page for the Navigation System: navmesh generation modes (Static, Dynamic, Dynamic Modifiers Only), RVO and Detour Crowd avoidance, with links to basic navigation, modifiers, custom areas/query filters, invokers, generation speed, resolutions, World Partition navmesh, auto nav links and navigation components.
Reference for Behavior Tree composite nodes Selector, Sequence and Simple Parallel, with their execution rules and properties.
gotchas: Only Composite nodes can attach to the Root node

summary: Reference for built-in Behavior Tree decorators (Blackboard, Compare BBEntries, Cone Check, Cooldown, Does Path Exist, Is At Location, Loop, Tag Cooldown, Time Limit, etc.) including Observer Aborts and Notify Observer options and custom decorators.
gotchas: Composite Decorators cost memory and performance; a C++ decorator is more efficient
Time Limit timer resets each time the node gains focus

summary: Reference for Behavior Tree services Default Focus and Run EQS, plus properties for custom Blueprint services (Interval, Random Deviation, etc.).
gotchas: Blueprint Services are less performant than C++ Services

summary: Reference for built-in Behavior Tree tasks: Finish With Result, Make Noise, Move Directly Toward, Move To, Play Animation, Play Sound, Rotate to face BB entry, Run Behavior/Run Behavior Dynamic, Run EQS Query, Set Tag Cooldown, Wait, Wait Blackboard Time, and custom tasks.
gotchas: Rotate to face BB entry requires Use Controller Rotation Yaw on the Pawn
Run Behavior subtree can't change at runtime; Run Behavior Dynamic doesn't support root-level decorators
Play Animation asset must match the Pawn's Skeleton
Blueprint Tasks are slower than native Tasks

summary: Conceptual overview of Unreal Behavior Trees: Blackboards, left-to-right execution order, running a tree from an AI Controller, and how UE's event-driven trees use decorators, Simple Parallel, Services and Observer Aborts instead of traditional parallel/conditional leaf nodes.
gotchas: Pawn needs a NavMeshBoundsVolume in the level to navigate

summary: Step-by-step build of an enemy AI in the Third Person template that patrols random points and chases the player on sight, using an AIController, Blackboard, Behavior Tree, custom BTT tasks, AIPerception sight, timers and a Blackboard decorator with Observer Aborts.
gotchas: Set Auto Possess AI to Spawned if the AI is spawned after level load
Affiliation can't be set in Blueprint; use Detect Neutrals plus a Player tag
Use the AI versions of Receive Execute/Abort/Tick when the agent is an AI Controller
Compile the character Blueprint before its function appears in the task
